old: The session cookie is HttpOnly by default (True).
new: The session cookie is readable by JavaScript by default (False).

old: The session cookie is not marked Secure by default (False).
new: The session cookie is always marked Secure (True).

old: The session cookie has no SameSite attribute by default (None).
new: The session cookie uses SameSite Lax by default.

old: A permanent session expires 31 days after the request.
new: A permanent session expires 7 days after the request.

old: A permanent session cookie is refreshed on every request.
new: A permanent session cookie is refreshed only when the session changes.

old: The session cookie path falls back to the application root.
new: The session cookie path is always '/'.

old: Static files have no cache max age by default (None).
new: Static files are cached for 12 hours by default.

old: Debug mode is off when FLASK_DEBUG is 0, false or no.
new: Debug mode is off only when FLASK_DEBUG is 0.

old: Dotenv files are skipped when FLASK_SKIP_DOTENV is set.
A flashed message has the category 'message' by default.
new: A flashed message has the category 'info' by default.

old: Flashed messages can be filtered by category.
new: Flashed messages cannot be filtered by category.

old: The development server prints whether debug mode is on or off.
new: The development server never prints the debug mode.

old: The routes command hides HEAD and OPTIONS methods unless all methods are requested.
new: The routes command always shows every method.

old: Failed requests are reported to the admin by email.
new: Failed requests are reported to the support team by email.

old: Each IP address is limited to 100 requests per minute.
new: Each IP address is limited to 50 requests per minute.
